name: Voice agent
responsibility: The host's one entry: createVoiceAgent turns its directory, checkouts, origins, instructions and extensions into one workbench, connects each browser socket through agent.connect and announces changes
description: start, status and shutdown come from the workbench it creates. agent.connect(socket, route) registers a socket at once, before Codex is ready and across Codex restarts, from any WebSocket library on Bun. A { request } route is admitted from its upgrade: a loopback Host with an exact same-origin match, or a listed origin, else 1008 before registration; an upgrade without an Origin header stays admitted. A route that names its identity is the host's to admit. receive(frame) returns false at once for a frame that is not a voice request, and answers the three refusals in their envelope, wording and order; close() releases the connection. bunHandlers({ path }) is a thin Bun.serve adapter over connect; the node:http attach, the socket factories and the lease ledger are gone. tabs is a read-only projection of the browser tabs, and voiceStartTrace reads the last voice starts for a host's route. The role profiles are composed here from the host's instructions, tools and identity, so every thread Codex is given carries the host's names and no other.
